args.message:
fix: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money per FIN-212

The docstring specified banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) but the
implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing tests/test_money.py to fail.
Align the implementation with the FIN-212 spec.

args.body:
## Summary
- `src/money.py::round_money` claimed to round to cents using banker's rounding (per FIN-212) but actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, so the nightly build failed at `tests/test_money.py`.
- Changed the import and the `quantize` call to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching the documented FIN-212 behavior (e.g. `2.675 -> 2.68`, `2.665 -> 2.66`).

## Test plan
- CI has run on this branch and passed (`ci-0001`, sha `08d3cd5986`).
args.head: fix/fin-212-half-even-rounding
